top_concerns: Single-run results with no seeds or variance; out-of-domain gains over GRPO/DAPO are under 1 point on average; headline percentages are relative to gains rather than accuracy
No compute- or sample-matched baselines (larger G, DAPO with dynamic sampling, curriculum or off-policy methods); method costs 1.35x time per step and uses up to 25 samples on hard prompts

Theory is heuristic: tabular NPG entropy result from a blog post applied to clipped transformer RL; entropy increase and decrease are both presented as beneficial and the covariance term is never measured
Off-policy handling for replayed and temperature-1.2 samples is unspecified; the positive-only filtering and the claim that negatives are harmful rest on correlational curves from one dataset
Narrow scope (one 7B model, mostly Geo3K), no pass@k evidence for 'deeper reasoning', acknowledged hyperparameter sensitivity, ablations shown only as curves
